name: Cheesy Broiled Pork Chops with Pineapple Salsa & Roasted Asparagus

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and cook until golden brown, about 2 minutes per side (they will not be cooked all the way through).
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
When the chops are done, divide between two large baking sheet pans, arranging on one half of each baking sheet. Sprinkle with cheese and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry asparagus. Snap (or cut) off woody ends and arrange on the other half of each baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, place baking sheets in the oven and broil until the chops are cooked through, cheese is melted, and asparagus softens slightly, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Place in a medium bowl, along with the salsa, and stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
1 ½ cup salsa

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide pork chops, asparagus, and pineapple salsa between plates. Enjoy!
